NOTIFICATION
In continuation to Commission's Result Notification no. PSC-R (A)/02/2021 Dated
23.d August, 2022, this is to inform all the eligible candidates who have qualified for the
post of Medical Physicist, that the Commission has fixed the date for Interview/Viva-
Voce on 16th September,2O22 at APPSC Office, Itanagar.
Further, the candidates are directed to upload the self-attested Xerox Copies of the
following documents in Pdf format, not exceeding 1mb size through their login id in the
Commission's website www.oppsc.gov.in on or before 7th September, 2022 from the issue of
this notification.
1. Matriculation Certificate (Class XJ issued by board for proof of date of birth.
2. Class XII Certificate and Marksheet
3. Degree Certificate and Marksheet issued by Registrar/Assistant
Registrar/Controller of Examination/Vice-Chancellor of the concerned
universiry to ascertain educational qualifi cation.
4. APST Certificate
5. NOC Certificate for those who are in regular service.
Candidates may download their Admit Cards w.e.f. 09-09-2022 to lS-9-2022 till 4
PM from the Commission's website www.aDpsc.aov.in.
